environment.description: Same EC2 instance and application code deployed in an isolated account within an AWS Organization. The account has an SCP (Service Control Policy) attached at the OU level that includes a Deny statement for 'ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute' and 'iam:*' actions preventing privilege escalation. The EC2 instance role has an IAM Permission Boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/BoundaryNoExternalNetworkMutation) that denies 'ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress', 'ec2:CreateSecurityGroup', 'elasticloadbalancing:*', and 's3:PutBucketPolicy'. Additionally, the instance runs behind an ALB with an associated AWS WAF WebACL that includes the AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_HEADER rule group action set to BLOCK (max header value size 4096 bytes) and a custom rule evaluating HTTP response headers via a Lambda@Edge function that strips any header value containing bytes 0x0D or 0x0A (carriage return / line feed) before forwarding to the client. The Lambda@Edge is deployed as an origin-response trigger on the associated CloudFront distribution sitting in front of the ALB.

config.lambda_edge_function: strips header values containing 0x0D or 0x0A bytes
